name: std::setfill
intro: When used in an expression out << setfill(c) sets the fill character of the stream out to c.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
c

 -

 new value for the fill character

sections.title: Return value
Notes
sections.text: The current fill character may be obtained with std::ostream::fill.

summary: When used in an expression out << setfill(c) sets the fill character of the stream out to c.
